comment: INIT-011 EPIC-028: which human-facing root documents are mirrored into which languages, and how each mirror stays honest. READMEs are held current by the push-gate status-badge and version-in-prose checks; the smaller root docs carry a synced-to digest pin equal to the SHA-256 of their English source, so a translation cannot silently drift from the bytes it was translated from. LICENSE and NOTICE are the authoritative legal texts and are deliberately NOT translated; CHANGELOG.md and SUPPORT.md are English-only for now. STORY-300: a rootdoc may declare mirrorDirectory. GitHub resolves most community health files by exact filename but resolves the code of conduct by matching the family and taking the first, so CODE_OF_CONDUCT.fr.md displaced the English one as the policy this repository shows the world -- a file that opens by saying the English version is authoritative. Moving those mirrors out of the root leaves exactly one file in the family, and this field is how the gate follows them.
